title.narrative: Supporting Data Analysis and Rule of Law Reporting in the State of Kuwait 2025

description.narrative: This project will assess the rule of law landscape in the state of Kuwait through surveys and polls that will measure adherence to the rule of law. This will subsequently feed into the rule of law index for the year 2025. The project will also analyze local and international indicators. The outcomes of the projects are expected to help policymakers and practitioners to identify strengths and weaknesses; draw attention to issues that must be addressed; and set goals, policies, and targets aimed at improving governance and well-being.
